title: TT/profile bar color 3.1.0
body: Please chage the TT/Profile bar color, that yellow has very high contrast with the black background, especially that the TT/star signs on it are white and so badly visible. On 3.0.0.1 where the background is grey the yellow looks OK, on 3.1.0 where background is black and the yellow is more bright it doesn't look good togeather. Maybe some blue color would be good but really annoying this way, please make a softer color at least optional.
